DIAGNOSIS READY: Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD)

This 9-year-old male exhibits classic signs of ODD, including a pattern of angry/irritable mood, argumentative/defiant behavior, and vindictiveness toward authority figures at home and school. His refusal to participate in directed activities and dismissive comments ("You're not the boss of me") are characteristic. However, his positive social interactions with peers and active engagement in unstructured physical activities (recess) suggest the issue is specifically related to authority and compliance, not global social deficits like Autism Spectrum Disorder.

I would like to confirm if these behaviors have been present for at least six months and if there is any history of similar defiance towards other authority figures outside the home.
